metadata.title: Enterprise PII Guardrails 1-Click Azure VM Deployment
metadata.description: Launches a hardened, production-ready Ubuntu VM preconfigured with an active evaluation license (10,000 requests included), persistent encrypted storage, and automated systemd container management.
metadata.author: Enterprise PII Guardrails Team

metadata.description: Name for the Virtual Machine and associated network resources.
Administrator username for logging into the Ubuntu Virtual Machine via SSH.
Type of authentication to use for SSH access to the Virtual Machine.
SSH Public Key (e.g. 'ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2E...') or Administrator Password for the VM. Passwords must be 12-72 characters with upper, lower, digit, and special characters.
Master administrative password to access the Enterprise PII Guardrails Studio Web UI (username: admin). Must be at least 8 characters.
Source IPv4 address or CIDR range allowed to connect to Studio Web UI (Port 8000) and SSH (Port 22). Use '*' to allow all, or restrict to your corporate IP range (e.g., '203.0.113.25/32').
Preconfigured evaluation license key (10,000 requests quota included). Leave as default to evaluate immediately, or replace with your commercial production key.
Location for all resources. Defaults to the resource group's location.

osProfile.customData:
[base64(concat('#!/bin/bash
set -e
exec > >(tee /var/log/customdata.log|logger -t customdata -s 2>/dev/console) 2>&1

echo "=========================================================="
echo "Initializing Enterprise PII Guardrails 1-Click Environment"
echo "=========================================================="

# 1. Update OS packages and install Docker runtime (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS)
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y docker.io curl openssl
systemctl enable --now docker

# 2. Setup persistent host directory for encrypted SQLCipher database
mkdir -p /opt/piiguardrails/data
chmod 777 /opt/piiguardrails/data

# 3. Generate high-entropy SQLCipher database encryption passphrase
RANDOM_PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -hex 16)

# 4. Write secure runtime environment file (restricted to root chmod 600)
cat <<EOF > /etc/piiguardrails.env
ACCEPT_LICENSE=true
GUI_PASSWORD=', parameters('adminStudioPassword'), '
SQLCIPHER_PASSPHRASE=$RANDOM_PASSPHRASE
PRECONFIGURED_LICENSE_KEY=', parameters('trialLicenseKey'), '
PORT=8000
APP_PORT=8000
APP_HOST=0.0.0.0
DATA_DIR=/app/data
EOF
chmod 600 /etc/piiguardrails.env

# 5. Create Systemd Service for continuous container availability
cat <<EOF > /etc/systemd/system/piiguardrail.service
[Unit]
Description=Enterprise PII Guardrails Engine
After=docker.service
Requires=docker.service

[Service]
TimeoutStartSec=0
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker stop pii-guardrail-app
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm pii-guardrail-app
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/docker pull piiguardrails/piiguardrails:latest
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --name pii-guardrail-app -p 8000:8000 -v /opt/piiguardrails/data:/app/data --env-file /etc/piiguardrails.env piiguardrails/piiguardrails:latest
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker stop pii-guardrail-app

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

# 6. Enable and start service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now piiguardrail.service

echo "=========================================================="
echo "Enterprise PII Guardrails container launched successfully!"
echo "=========================================================="
'))]
